comment: Independent C-first human Priestess with symset:Enhanced1 (Handling: UTF8) and msg_window:full. ';' farlooks the wall east of the hero; decode_mixed() puts that glyph's three UTF-8 bytes (U+2502, E2 94 82) at the head of the message, so gt.toplines and the history ring begin with them. Ctrl-P lists the history in a text window: wintty.c process_text_window() sends the line's first byte through g_putch(), whose recorder hook (patch 006) strips the high bit and stores 'b' one column right of the line start, and the next two bytes go through the putchar() hook as negative chars, which nomux_putch() ignores, so the 'b' stays in column 1. A stored message that replaces those bytes with a stand-in leaves the cell blank.
